cars.variant: Series 2 AMG — creator-interview technical reference; build year unspecified
cars.specification_market: Motorikonen’s original Eberhard Schulz interview page explicitly labels its technical block Series 2 AMG. It gives no build year for that reference, so year fields stay unset; 1984 is the family’s production origin, not a claimed date for this 6.0-litre engine. The CW311 prototype’s M100, early-series engines, ambiguous current-brand numeric tiles, build totals and performance claims are excluded.
cars.summary: The Imperator turned Eberhard Schulz’s CW311 concept into a substantially re-engineered production supercar. Its bespoke gullwing body, tubular construction and Mercedes-derived V8 preserve a distinctive independent German supercar lineage, rather than merely a rare specification.
cars.admission_reason: The Imperator turned Eberhard Schulz’s CW311 concept into a substantially re-engineered production supercar. cars.generation: Original first-generation Tesla Roadster production-road sports-car family
cars.specification_market: Factory manual cover identifies 2008 Roadster; imprint is 27 January 2009, revision AB. Actual cover, owner introduction, tyre table and subsystem pages 11-17–19 rendered/read. The selected manual specifies a single-speed configuration; not every early delivery shared it. Power/torque ratings, ratio stages, range, energy capacity, later 2.x/Sport/2.5 and the future new Roadster are omitted.
cars.summary: The original Roadster established Tesla’s production sports-car programme and high-performance electric identity. Its significance is the move from a new manufacturer’s concept into a customer road car, rather than a later trim or power increase.
cars.admission_reason: The original Roadster established Tesla’s production sports-car programme and high-performance electric identity. Its significance is the move from a new manufacturer’s concept into a customer road car, rather than a later trim or power increase.
